name: queryQuadrantOverview
shortDescription: Fetches detailed information for a specific Quadrant, including linked categories and assigned Stump participants.
description:
Overview

Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific Quadrant, including its associated Categorys and QuadrantParticipants.

Intended use

Called by the Quadrant and Participant Detail View UI or an AI agent to display detailed information about a quadrant. Parameter is quadrantId.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the Quadrant record using params.quadrantId via ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  2. Query QuadrantCategory entities linked to params.quadrantId using ctx.data.query.
  3. For each QuadrantCategory, retrieve the associated Category details using ctx.data.get.
  4. Query QuadrantParticipant entities linked to params.quadrantId using ctx.data.query.
  5. For each QuadrantParticipant, retrieve the associated User (Stump) details using ctx.data.get.
  6. Combine the Quadrant data with its categories and participants into a single response object.
  7. Return the combined data.

Entities

  • Quadrant
  • QuadrantCategory
  • Category
  • QuadrantParticipant
  • User
